test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

The administration has set the following criteria for the selection of a teacher in school. The candidate must:

A. Be a graduate with at least 50% marks

B. Have a qualified bachelor's degree in education

C. Not be less than 21 Years and not more than 32 years as on 1st July 2021.

D. For a candidate with Master in Education, the school board may relax the upper age limit.

Rahul Verma is teaching in a reputed school He is 1st class graduate. He was 23 years old when he joined the previous school as a teacher. He has also completed B.Ed.

options.text: The case is to be referred to the school board.
The data given are not sufficient to take a decision.
The candidate is not to be appointed.
The candidate is to be appointed.

solution:
On the basis of the criteria for the selection and the information given about Rahul, the following deductions can be made-

A. Be a graduate with at least 50% marks → Yes, Rahul satisfies this criterion as he is a 1st class (60% or more) graduate.

B. Have a qualified bachelor's degree in education → Yes, Rahul satisfies this criterion since he has also completed B.Ed.

C. Not be less than 21 years and not more than 32 years as on 1st July 2021. → No information about his ***present age*** is provided.

D. For a candidate with Master in Education, the school board may relax the upper age limit. → No information about Rahul's Masters is mentioned anywhere.

 
• As no information about Rahul's age or Masters is provided, so a decision can not be taken.

​Hence, **'option 2' **is the correct answer.
